void merge(int a[], int b[], int c[], int p, int q, int r) {
    int n1 = q - p + 1;
    int n2 = r - q;
    int* L = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R = new int[n2 + 1];
    int* L1 = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R1 = new int[n2 + 1];
    int* L2 = new int[n1 + 1];
    int* R2 = new int[n2 + 1];

    for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++) {
        L[i] = a[p + i];
        L1[i] = b[p + i];
        L2[i] = c[p + i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n2; i++) {
        R[i] = a[q + 1 + i];
        R1[i] = b[q + 1 + i];
        R2[i] = c[q + 1 + i];
    }

    L[n1] = R[n2] = INF;
    L1[n1] = R1[n2] = INF;
    L2[n1] = R2[n2] = INF;

    int i = 0, j = 0;
    for (int k = p; k <= r; k++) {
        if (L[i] < R[j]) {
            a[k] = L[i];
            b[k] = L1[i];
            c[k] = L2[i++];
        } else if (L[i] > R[j]) {
            a[k] = R[j];

    delete[] R;
    delete[] L1;
    delete[] R1;
    delete[] L2;
    delete[] R2;
}

int* sieve(int n) {
    int* a = new int[n + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = (i >= 2) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int j = i * i; j <= n; j += i) {
                a[j] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

long long sum(int a) {
    long long su = 0;
    while (a > 0) {
        su += a % 10;
        a /= 10;
    }
    return su;
}

bool prime(int n) {
    if (n == 1) return true;
    if (n < 2) return false;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
        if (n % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long t = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = t;
    }
    return a;
}

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; ++i) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) {
                q.push_back(m / i);
            }
        }
    }
    return q;
}

long long sum(long long n) {

int divisors(int n, int m) {
    if (n - (m + (m * m)) >= 0) {
        return m;
    }
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(m); i >= 1; i--) {
        if (m % i == 0 && n - (m + (m * i)) >= 0) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

bool cal(int val, int k, int t) {
    int res = val, p = 1;
    while (val / (int)pow(k, p) > 0) {
        res += val / (int)pow(k, p);
        p++;
    }
    return res >= t;
}

int Last_Ocuu(int a[], int n, long long v) {
    int start = 0, end = n - 1, ans = -1;
    while (start <= end) {
        int mid = start + ((end - start) >> 1);
        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool Last_Ocuu(long long a[], int n, long long v) {
    int sta = 0, end = n - 1;
    while (sta <= end) {
        int mid = sta + ((end - sta) >> 1);
        if (a[mid] == v) {
            return true;
        } else if (a[mid] > v) {
            end = mid - 1;
        } else {
            sta = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

class Scannerr {

    vector<int> sol;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;

        if (even == odd) {
            sol.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    
    sort(sol.begin(), sol.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < sol.size(); i++) {
        if (sol[i] <= B) {
            ++ans;
            B -= sol[i];
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
